messages:
Elaine: Quick sync — drafting the PRD for structured output + tool/function calling. Need a short launch-readiness checklist focused on acceptance criteria, schema validation, and graceful degradation for customer-driven asks. Owners, drop required items by EOD?

Maks: Runtime notes: define SLOs for validation-enabled paths: p95 <= 120ms, p99 <= 300ms. Also include a cost-delta estimate for strict validation vs relaxed/warn mode.

Sanjay: Acceptance criteria proposal:
- schema validation must reject invalid types with a documented error code
- fallback to best-effort text when a tool call fails (configurable)
- metrics surfaced per-route (validation rejects, fallback rate)
Short version: errors are structured, observable, and actionable.

Lee: From experiments: partial KV cache + function call sometimes yields truncated args. Need a max-arg-length cap, deterministic truncation policy, and an explicit warning field when truncation occurs.

Carla: Customer success note: enterprise customers expect deterministic failure behavior. If we change schema semantics, provide a 2-week deprecation window and an opt-in flag for the new semantics.

Maria: QA matrix (short):
- happy path: schema match -> tool invoked
- shape mismatch: reject, do not call tool
- missing optional fields: proceed using defaults
- nested arrays with mixed types -> reject
- streaming response interrupted -> surface partial result + structured error

qa-bot: auto-summary: added test cases to pipeline: schema_happy, schema_mismatch, optional_defaults, nested_array_reject, stream_interruption.

Sanjay: Telemetry acceptance criteria:
- increment validation_rejects{route} on each rejection
- sample payload capture for ~1/1000 rejected cases (redact PII)
- alert if rejection rate > 0.5% sustained over 10m for any route

Lee: Security: tool args that embed external URLs must be sanitized. Policy: no remote code execution via tool args; all external URLs passed into tools must be validated against our safe-list service.

Carla: Add customer-facing error mapping table. Example: validation_type_error -> 400 + body {code: "VALIDATION_TYPE", message: "expected integer"}. Provide migration guidance.

Maks: Runtime config flags we need in the PRD: 
``
validation_mode: enum{off, warn, strict}
schema_version: string
fallback_policy: enum{no_fallback, best_effort_text, stub_tool}
```
Behavior notes: strict mode blocks tool calls on mismatch; warn mode logs and continues.

Elaine: Rollout gates: canary 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Roll back if error budget for route crosses 0.5% within 30m. Document customer opt-out for strict mode (org-level flag).

Maria: QA request: add fuzzing of tool args and simulated tool latency/timeouts to catch nulls and strange partial outputs. Add nightly fuzz job.

Sanjay: Error contract (minimal example):
{
  "code": "VALIDATION_ERROR",
  "message": "string",
  "field_path": "string | null",
  "received": "string | null",
  "expected": "string | null",
  "retryable": boolean
}
Retryable should be true for transient failures (tool timeout), false for schema mismatches.

devex: SDK changes: add parsing helpers and opt-in strict validation. Example helper: parseStructured(response, schema, {mode: 'warn'}) -> {ok, parsed, errors}. Add migration snippets for customers.

security-bot: Note: any sampled payload capture MUST redact PII by default and follow KMS/HSM policy. Use hashing for high-risk fields and store samples with restricted retention.

Carla: Enterprise ask: on-prem hook for custom validation functions in Private deployments. Add an RFC item for pluggable validators and review security implications.

Maria: Acceptance checklist for PRD (short):
- [ ] SLOs defined (p95/p99 latencies)
- [ ] Validation modes implemented (off/warn/strict)
- [ ] Error contract documented and returned consistently
- [ ] Telemetry: rejection counts, sample captures, alerts
- [ ] Rollout plan with canary gates and rollback triggers
- [ ] SDK helpers and migration docs
- [ ] QA test matrix + fuzzing in CI
- [ ] Security redaction and URL safe-list

Elaine: Action items: Maks -> fill runtime cost-delta numbers; Sanjay -> formalize the error contract in the spec; Maria -> add CI job names and test details; Lee -> finalize truncation policy and safe-list integration; Carla -> draft deprecation/opt-out wording and customer comms. Ping me when RFC PRs are ready so I can link them in the PRD. Closing this thread for now.

Maks: On it, will post numbers tomorrow AM.

Sanjay: Opening a small RFC PR with the error JSON + example responses.

Maria: Queuing QA tests and adding nightly fuzz job.

Lee: Drafting truncation policy and safe-list integration doc.

Carla: Drafting customer-facing communication template for deprecation and opt-out.

Elaine: Thanks all — please link RFC PRs here and I will fold into the PRD.
